claim_violated: server-side fetches cannot be pointed at internal infrastructure (SSRF)
expected: The webhook `test` action (POST ?action=test) fetches a tenant-stored URL and reflects up to 200 chars of the response back to the caller. Webhook URLs are only validated for https: protocol at creation (line 165) with NO private-IP / internal-host / DNS-rebind guard. An authenticated org user with webhooks:manage can register an https URL resolving to an internal service and use test (or normal dispatch via lib/webhook.ts dispatchWebhook) to probe the internal network and read responses. The codebase already implements the correct guard in src/app/api/proxy-video/route.ts (isAllowedUrl: blocks localhost/127.0.0.1/0.0.0.0/10./192.168./172./169.254.169.254/.internal/.local).
